H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H5081: properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H8668: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H6231: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H5425: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie
H631: to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle
H6491: to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H1616: properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner
H490: a widow; also a desolate place
H5749: to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H4427: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
